card: This PR turns linker warnings into fatal build errors for macOS CI and Guix environments using `-DCMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON`. Currently, linker warnings on macOS can pass unnoticed in CI, risking unaddressed linking anomalies. It includes CMake policy updates to eliminate existing Apple linker duplicate library warnings under CMake 3.31+. This PR depends on #35756.
evidence: PR description: "Turn linker warnings into errors, so that any future warnings are caught."

Commit 50fb8fc483 message: "CMP0156 de-duplicates libraries on link lines based on linker capabilities; CMP0179 makes this de-duplication keep the first occurrence of static libraries. This silences Apple linker 'ignoring duplicate libraries' warnings."
problem: Linker warnings on macOS are not treated as errors in CI or Guix, permitting new warnings or subtle linking issues to be introduced without failing the build.

risk.why: A faulty linker flag or an unsuppressed benign linker warning on macOS could break CI or Guix release builds.

scope_notes: Contains a base commit from PR #35756 that updates CMake link-line deduplication policies before turning on warning-as-error flags in CI and Guix configurations.
summary: Enables `-DCMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON` for macOS CI and Guix builds to treat linker warnings as fatal errors. It also sets CMake policies CMP0156 and CMP0179 to deduplicate libraries on link lines, resolving existing Apple linker duplicate library warnings when built with CMake 3.31 or newer.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, so exact CI and Guix file modifications cannot be confirmed directly.
